BOOK2_LESSON_THREE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–7 · I Want to Rent a House

text.traditional: （良介去看房子，他和可欣到了公寓的門口，房東王太太剛好出來了。）
text.simplified: （良介去看房子，他和可欣到了公寓的门口，房东王太太刚好出来了。）
text.pinyin: (Liángjiè qù kàn fángzi, tā hé Kěxīn dào le gōngyù de ménkǒu, fángdōng Wáng tàitai gānghǎo chūlái le.)
text.english: (Ryosuke goes to view a house. When Kexin and he arrive at the gate of the apartment building, Mrs. Wang, the landlord just shows up.)

text.traditional: 王太太，您好。我是陳可欣。這位是我的朋友山本良介，我陪他來看房子。
text.simplified: 王太太，您好。我是陈可欣。这位是我的朋友山本良介，我陪他来看房子。
text.pinyin: Wáng tàitai, nín hǎo. Wǒ shì Chén Kěxīn. Zhè wèi shì wǒ de péngyǒu Shānběn Liángjiè, wǒ péi tā lái kàn fángzi.
text.english: Hello, Mrs. Wang. I'm Kexin Chen. This is my friend, Yamamoto Ryosuke. I come with him to view the house.

text.traditional: 你們好！這棟公寓一共有六層，我要出租的房子在四樓，我們一起上去看看吧！
text.simplified: 你们好！这栋公寓一共有六层，我要出租的房子在四楼，我们一起上去看看吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo! Zhè dòng gōngyù yígòng yǒu liù céng, wǒ yào chūzū de fángzi zài sì lóu, wǒmen yìqǐ shàngqù kànkan ba!
text.english: Hello! This is a six-story apartment building, and the apartment I'd like to rent out is on the fourth floor. Let's go up and have a look.

text.traditional: 好的。對了，請問有家具嗎？
text.simplified: 好的。对了，请问有家具吗？
text.pinyin: Hǎo de. Duìle, qǐngwèn yǒu jiājù ma?
text.english: OK. Oh! By the way, is there any furniture?

text.traditional: 有。臥室有床、書桌、椅子、沙發，還有一個大衣櫃，可以掛很多衣服，而且冰箱、洗衣機都是新的。
text.simplified: 有。卧室有床、书桌、椅子、沙发，还有一个大衣柜，可以挂很多衣服，而且冰箱、洗衣机都是新的。
text.pinyin: Yǒu. Wòshì yǒu chuáng, shūzhuō, yǐzi, shāfā, háiyǒu yíge dà yīguì, kěyǐ guà hěn duō yīfu, érqiě bīngxiāng, xǐyījī dōu shì xīn de.
text.english: Yes, there are a bed, a desk, a chair and a sofa in the bedroom. There's also a big closet where you can hang up many clothes. Also, both the refrigerator and the washing machine are new.

text.traditional: （三人到了四樓）
text.simplified: （三人到了四楼）
text.pinyin: (Sān rén dào le sì lóu)
text.english: (The three reach the fourth floor)

text.traditional: 請進！我給你們介紹介紹。這是客廳，右邊是廚房，臥室和浴室在那邊。
text.simplified: 请进！我给你们介绍介绍。这是客厅，右边是厨房，卧室和浴室在那边。
text.pinyin: Qǐng jìn! Wǒ gěi nǐmen jièshào jièshào. Zhè shì kètīng, yòubiān shì chúfáng, wòshì hé yùshì zài nàbiān.
text.english: Come in, please. Let me show you around. This is the living room. The kitchen is on the right. The bedroom and the bathroom are there.

text.traditional: 房間看起來很好！請問附近有超級市場嗎？
text.simplified: 房间看起来很好！请问附近有超级市场吗？
text.pinyin: Fángjiān kànqǐlái hěn hǎo! Qǐngwèn fùjìn yǒu chāojíshìchǎng ma?
text.english: The room looks nice! Is there any supermarket nearby?

text.traditional: 有啊！從這裡出去，走五分鐘就有超市和便利商店了。
text.simplified: 有啊！从这里出去，走五分钟就有超市和便利商店了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu a! Cóng zhèlǐ chūqù, zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù yǒu chāoshì hé biànlì shāngdiàn le.
text.english: Yes, there is. Go out from here, the supermarket and convenience store are just a five-minute walk away.

text.traditional: 這裡有網路嗎？
text.simplified: 这里有网路吗？
text.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu wǎnglù ma?
text.english: Is the Internet access available here?

text.traditional: 沒有，我可以替你裝網路，可是每個月的費用要自己付。
text.simplified: 没有，我可以替你装网路，可是每个月的费用要自己付。
text.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ kěyǐ tì nǐ zhuāng wǎnglù, kěshì měi ge yuè de fèiyòng yào zìjǐ fù.
text.english: No. I can set up the Internet connection for you, but you have to pay the monthly fee yourself.

text.traditional: 聽起來不錯。請問房租一個月多少錢？
text.simplified: 听起来不错。请问房租一个月多少钱？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái búcuò. Qǐngwèn fángzū yíge yuè duōshǎo qián?
text.english: Sounds pretty good. How much is the rent each month?

text.traditional: 一個月一萬五千塊，不包括水費、電費，還要兩個月的押金。
text.simplified: 一个月一万五千块，不包括水费、电费，还要两个月的押金。
text.pinyin: Yíge yuè yíwànwǔqiān kuài, bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi, háiyào liǎng ge yuè de yājīn.
text.english: It's $15,000 a month, water and electricity not included. Two-month rental deposit is also needed.

text.traditional: 好，我先跟我朋友討論一下，請您等一會兒。
text.simplified: 好，我先跟我朋友讨论一下，请您等一会儿。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xiān gēn wǒ péngyǒu tǎolùn yíxià, qǐng nín děng yìhuǐr.
text.english: OK. I'd like to discuss with my friend first. Please wait a moment.

text.traditional: 你覺得這裡怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 你觉得这里怎么样？
text.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhèlǐ zěnmeyàng?
text.english: What do you think of this place?

text.traditional: 這邊的環境不錯，可是付了房租以後，我的獎學金就只剩一萬塊了。
text.simplified: 这边的环境不错，可是付了房租以后，我的奖学金就只剩一万块了。
text.pinyin: Zhèbiān de huánjìng búcuò, kěshì fù le fángzū yǐhòu, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn jiù zhǐ shèng yíwàn kuài le.
text.english: The environment here is not bad, but after I pay the rent, I'll only have $10,000 of my scholarship left.

text.traditional: 這樣的房子都不便宜。你問問王太太，房租能不能便宜一點兒。
text.simplified: 这样的房子都不便宜。你问问王太太，房租能不能便宜一点儿。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng de fángzi dōu bù piányí. Nǐ wèn wèn Wáng tàitai, fángzū néng bùnéng piányí yìdiǎnr.
text.english: All the houses of this kind are not cheap. Ask Mrs. Wang if she can lower the rent.

text.traditional: 王太太，這個公寓我很滿意，可是房租有一點兒貴，可以便宜一點兒嗎？
text.simplified: 王太太，这个公寓我很满意，可是房租有一点儿贵，可以便宜一点儿吗？
text.pinyin: Wáng tàitai, zhège gōngyù wǒ hěn mǎnyì, kěshì fángzū yǒuyìdiǎnr guì, kěyǐ piányí yìdiǎnr ma?
text.english: Mrs. Wang, I'm quite satisfied with this apartment, but the rent is a little bit expensive. Can it be a little cheaper?

text.traditional: 我想想……你是留學生吧？我兒子也去法國留學了，我知道外國人找房子不太容易。
text.simplified: 我想想……你是留学生吧？我儿子也去法国留学了，我知道外国人找房子不太容易。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiǎng… nǐ shì liúxuéshēng ba? Wǒ érzi yě qù Fǎguó liúxué le, wǒ zhīdào wàiguórén zhǎo fángzi bú tài róngyì.
text.english: Let me think about it... You're an international student, aren't you? My son has also been studying in France, so I know it's not easy for a foreigner to find a house.

text.traditional: 對啊！我看了好幾個地方，有的環境很好，可是房租太貴；有些房東一看我是外國人，就不願意租給我了。
text.simplified: 对啊！我看了好几个地方，有的环境很好，可是房租太贵；有些房东一看我是外国人，就不愿意租给我了。
text.pinyin: Duì a! Wǒ kàn le hǎojǐ ge dìfāng, yǒude huánjìng hěn hǎo, kěshì fángzū tài guì; yǒuxiē fángdōng yí kàn wǒ shì wàiguórén, jiù bú yuànyì zū gěi wǒ le.
text.english: That's right! I've visited several places. Some of them, the environment is not bad, but the rent is too expensive. Some landlords were unwilling to rent out to me on seeing I'm a foreigner.

text.traditional: 好吧！你那麼喜歡，那就一個月一萬兩千塊。
text.simplified: 好吧！你那么喜欢，那就一个月一万两千块。
text.pinyin: Hǎo ba! Nǐ nàme xǐhuān, nà jiù yíge yuè yíwànliǎngqiān kuài.
text.english: Alright! Now that you like this apartment so much, I'll just charge you $12,000 each month.

text.traditional: 太好了！謝謝您，我決定租半年。下個星期一可以簽約嗎？
text.simplified: 太好了！谢谢您，我决定租半年。下个星期一可以签约吗？
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie nín, wǒ juédìng zū bàn nián. Xià ge xīngqíyī kěyǐ qiānyuē ma?
text.english: That's great! Thank you. I decide to rent it for half a year. May I sign the lease next Monday?

text.traditional: 可以，你過來簽約的時候請帶護照、房租和兩個月的押金。簽約以後會給你鑰匙，你就可以搬進來了。
text.simplified: 可以，你过来签约的时候请带护照、房租和两个月的押金。签约以后会给你钥匙，你就可以搬进来了。
text.pinyin: Kěyǐ, nǐ guòlái qiānyuē de shíhòu qǐng dài hùzhào, fángzū hé liǎng ge yuè de yājīn. Qiānyuē yǐhòu huì gěi nǐ yàoshi, nǐ jiù kěyǐ bān jìnlái le.
text.english: Yes. When you come to sign the lease, please bring your passport, rent and a two-month deposit. After the lease is signed, I'll give you the keys and you can move in.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Directional verb + 來 / 去 (1 of 4)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether movement comes toward you or goes away: come up, go down, come in, go out.
grammarPages.explanation: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. The structures include: (1) directional verb + 來/去, (2) motion verb + directional verb + 來/去, (3) motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去, (4) combined with 把 construction to indicate the Subject moves the Object to another location: S + 把 + O + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來/去.

text.traditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上來。
text.simplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài èr lóu, qǐng shàng lái.
text.english: My room is on the second floor. Please come up.

text.traditional: 爸爸有事找你，你趕快過去。
text.simplified: 爸爸有事找你，你赶快过去。
text.pinyin: Bàba yǒu shì zhǎo nǐ, nǐ gǎnkuài guòqù.
text.english: Dad is looking for you. Hurry over.

text.traditional: 他出去一會兒，五分鐘以後就回來。
text.simplified: 他出去一会儿，五分钟以后就回来。
text.pinyin: Tā chūqù yìhuǐr, wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù huí lái.
text.english: He went out for a while; he will be back in five minutes.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. text.traditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面走出來了。
text.simplified: 爸爸从卧室里面走出来了。
text.pinyin: Bàba cóng wòshì lǐmiàn zǒu chū lái le.
text.english: Dad walked out of the bedroom.

text.traditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回去嗎？
text.simplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回去吗？
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē méi chīwán de miànbāo, wǒ kěyǐ dài huí qù ma?
text.english: Can I take these unfinished pieces of bread back with me?

text.traditional: 這部電腦很重，我們一起搬過去吧。
text.simplified: 这部电脑很重，我们一起搬过去吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo hěn zhòng, wǒmen yìqǐ bān guòqù ba.
text.english: This computer is heavy. Let's carry it over together.

text.traditional: 那些髒衣服不要放進衣櫃裡去。
text.simplified: 那些脏衣服不要放进衣柜里去。
text.pinyin: Nàxiē zāng yīfu búyào fàng jìn yīguì lǐ qù.
text.english: Don't put those dirty clothes into the closet.

text.traditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回日本去。
text.simplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回日本去。
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōng wén shū, Shānběn Liángjiè dōu yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
text.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto will take all these Chinese books back to Japan.

text.traditional: 路上的車很多，那個人從對面跑過街來，真危險！
text.simplified: 路上的车很多，那个人从对面跑过街来，真危险！
text.pinyin: Lùshang de chē hěn duō, nà gèrén cóng duìmiàn pǎo guò jiē lái, zhēn wéixiǎn!
text.english: There are many cars on the road. That person ran across the street from the opposite side. How dangerous!

text.traditional: 請你把那張書桌搬過來。
text.simplified: 请你把那张书桌搬过来。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ nà zhāng shūzhuō bān guòlái.
text.english: Please move that desk over here.

text.traditional: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上樓去了。
text.simplified: 姐姐把她的衣服拿上楼去了。
text.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ tā de yīfu ná shànglóu qù le.
text.english: My older sister took her clothes upstairs.

text.traditional: 我還沒把褲子從洗衣機裡拿出來。
text.simplified: 我还没把裤子从洗衣机里拿出来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ háiméi bǎ kùzi cóng xǐyījī lǐ ná chū lái.
text.english: I haven't taken the pants out of the washing machine yet.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a doubled two-syllable verb to say you will do something briefly and casually.
grammarPages.explanation: The reduplication of disyllabic verb, with the structure XYXY, creates a casual tone and implies the Subject is going to do something and the action is not going to take long. Note that this pattern cannot be used along with “一下 (in a while)” and “一點 (a little bit)”. e.g., “討論討論一下” is considered to be a wrong usage.

text.traditional: 他們都是我的同學，我給你介紹介紹。
text.simplified: 他们都是我的同学，我给你介绍介绍。
text.pinyin: Tāmen dōu shì wǒ de tóngxué, wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào jièshào.
text.english: They are all my classmates. Let me introduce them to you.

text.traditional: 我還沒決定要不要去留學，我要和父母討論討論。
text.simplified: 我还没决定要不要去留学，我要和父母讨论讨论。
text.pinyin: Wǒ háiméi juédìng yào búyào qù liúxué, wǒ yào hé fùmǔ tǎolùn tǎolùn.
text.english: I haven't decided whether to study abroad yet. I want to discuss it with my parents.

text.traditional: 弟弟的房間有一點兒髒，這個週末他要打掃打掃。
text.simplified: 弟弟的房间有一点儿脏，这个周末他要打扫打扫。
text.pinyin: Dìdi de fángjiān yǒuyìdiǎnr zāng, zhège zhōumò tā yào dǎsǎo dǎsǎo.
text.english: My younger brother's room is a little dirty. He will do some cleaning this weekend.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The reduplication of disyllabic verb, with the structure XYXY, creates a casual tone and implies the Subject is going to do something and the action is not going to take long. Note that this pattern cannot be used along with “一下 (in a while)” and “一點 (a little bit)”. e.g., “討論討論一下” is considered to be a wrong usage.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Judgemental 起來: how something seems
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use V起來 to say how something looks, sounds or feels.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern is used to make comments on someone or something. The verb placed before “起來” is often a monosyllabic sensory verb or action verb, such as “看 (look)”, “聽 (sound)”, 吃 (taste), “喝 (drink)”, “穿 (wear)”, etc. “起來” is followed by comments; thus, the structure is “V 起來 (+Adv) +Vs”.

text.traditional: A：王小姐看起來很害羞。B：是啊！她不敢跟不熟的男生說話。
text.simplified: A：王小姐看起来很害羞。B：是啊！她不敢跟不熟的男生说话。
text.pinyin: A: Wáng xiǎojiě kànqǐlái hěn hàixiū. B: Shì a! Tā bù gǎn gēn bù shóu de nánshēng shuōhuà.
text.english: A: Miss Wang looks shy. B: Yes! She doesn't dare talk to boys she doesn't know well.

text.traditional: A：明天放假，我們去動物園吧。B：聽起來不錯，我們幾點去呢？
text.simplified: A：明天放假，我们去动物园吧。B：听起来不错，我们几点去呢？
text.pinyin: A: Míngtiān fàngjià, wǒmen qù dòngwùyuán ba. B: Tīngqǐlái búcuò, wǒmen jǐdiǎn qù ne?
text.english: A: We're off tomorrow. Let's go to the zoo. B: That sounds good. What time shall we go?

text.traditional: A：這件裙子是今年最流行的。B：看起來不錯，你穿起來應該很好看。
text.simplified: A：这件裙子是今年最流行的。B：看起来不错，你穿起来应该很好看。
text.pinyin: A: Zhè jiàn qúnzi shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de. B: Kànqǐlái búcuò, nǐ chuān qǐlái yīnggāi hěn hǎokàn.
text.english: A: This skirt is the most popular style this year. B: It looks nice. It should look good on you.

The verb placed before “起來” is often a monosyllabic sensory verb or action verb, such as “看 (look)”, “聽 (sound)”, 吃 (taste), “喝 (drink)”, “穿 (wear)”, etc. “起來” is followed by comments; thus, the structure is “V 起來 (+Adv) +Vs”.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: 替: for or on behalf of someone
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that you do something for someone else with 替.
grammarPages.explanation: “替” is used in the situation when a person cannot do something for some reason and finds someone else to do it for him.

text.traditional: 你可以替我裝網路嗎？費用我自己付。
text.simplified: 你可以替我装网路吗？费用我自己付。
text.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ tì wǒ zhuāng wǎnglù ma? Fèiyòng wǒ zìjǐ fù.
text.english: Can you set up the internet for me? I'll pay the fee myself.

text.traditional: 昨天王老師不舒服，所以林老師替他上課。
text.simplified: 昨天王老师不舒服，所以林老师替他上课。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān Wáng lǎoshī bù shūfu, suǒyǐ Lín lǎoshī tì tā shàngkè.
text.english: Teacher Wang didn't feel well yesterday, so Teacher Lin taught the class for him.

text.traditional: 孩子應該自己打掃房間，父母不要常常替他們做。
text.simplified: 孩子应该自己打扫房间，父母不要常常替他们做。
text.pinyin: Háizi yīnggāi zìjǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān, fùmǔ búyào chángcháng tì tāmen zuò.
text.english: Children should clean their rooms themselves. Parents should not often do it for them.

BOOK2_LESSON_THREE_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 8–9 · Renting a House Is Not Easy

dialogue.title: 短文 · 租房子不容易

text.traditional: 山本良介來台灣以後，一直住在學校的宿舍，可是他下個學期不想住了，因為室友很晚才睡覺，總是在半夜開著燈打電腦，聲音很吵。除了生活習慣很不一樣，良介的室友還常常把房間弄得很髒，所以他決定到學校外面去租房子。
text.simplified: 山本良介来台湾以后，一直住在学校的宿舍，可是他下个学期不想住了，因为室友很晚才睡觉，总是在半夜开着灯打电脑，声音很吵。除了生活习惯很不一样，良介的室友还常常把房间弄得很脏，所以他决定到学校外面去租房子。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, yìzhí zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè, kěshì tā xià ge xuéqí bù xiǎng zhù le, yīnwèi shìyǒu hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào, zǒngshì zài bànyè kāi zhe dēng dǎ diànnǎo, shēngyīn hěn chǎo. Chúle shēnghuó xíguàn hěn bù yíyàng, Liángjiè de shìyǒu hái chángcháng bǎ fángjiān nòng dehěn zāng, suǒyǐ tā juédìng dào xuéxiào wàimiàn qù zū fángzi.
text.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he has always been living in the school dormitory, but he doesn't want to live there next semester. That was because his roommate slept late, always used the computer with the light on at midnight, and made a lot of noise. In addition to different living habits, Ryosuke's roommate often made their room dirty, so he decided to rent a house off-campus.

text.traditional: 良介本來覺得找房子不難，沒想到不太順利。他上租屋網站找了很多資料，可是看了好幾個地方都不滿意。有的房東一看他是外國人，就不太願意租給他。陳可欣知道他的問題以後，就決定陪他去找房子、看房子。
text.simplified: 良介本来觉得找房子不难，没想到不太顺利。他上租屋网站找了很多资料，可是看了好几个地方都不满意。有的房东一看他是外国人，就不太愿意租给他。陈可欣知道他的问题以后，就决定陪他去找房子、看房子。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè běnlái juéde zhǎo fángzi bù nán, méixiǎngdào bú tài shùnlì. Tā shàng zūwū wǎngzhàn zhǎo le hěn duō zīliào, kěshì kàn le hǎojǐ ge dìfāng dōu bù mǎnyì. Yǒude fángdōng yí kàn tā shì wàiguórén, jiù bú tài yuànyì zū gěi tā. Chén Kěxīn zhīdào tā de wèntí yǐhòu, jiù juédìng péi tā qù zhǎo fángzi, kàn fángzi.
text.english: Ryosuke supposed that finding a house was not difficult. He never thought that it would not go smoothly. He searched for a lot of information on house rental websites. However, after he viewed several places, he still was not satisfied. Some landlords were unwilling to rent out their houses to him just because he was a foreigner. After knowing his problem, Chen Kexin decided to accompany him to find and view houses.

text.traditional: 良介聽說王太太的公寓要出租，就找可欣一起去看看。那個公寓附近的環境不錯，離學校也不太遠。雖然良介很想租，但是付了房租以後，獎學金就只剩下一萬塊錢了。他問王太太，房租可不可以便宜一點兒。因為王太太的兒子在法國留學，她知道一個人在國外生活不容易。她想了想，決定只收良介一萬兩千元的房租，良介很高興可以搬家了。
text.simplified: 良介听说王太太的公寓要出租，就找可欣一起去看看。那个公寓附近的环境不错，离学校也不太远。虽然良介很想租，但是付了房租以后，奖学金就只剩下一万块钱了。他问王太太，房租可不可以便宜一点儿。因为王太太的儿子在法国留学，她知道一个人在国外生活不容易。她想了想，决定只收良介一万两千元的房租，良介很高兴可以搬家了。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè tīngshuō Wáng tàitai de gōngyù yào chūzū, jiù zhǎo Kěxīn yìqǐ qù kànkan. Nàge gōngyù fùjìn de huánjìng búcuò, lí xuéxiào yě bú tài yuǎn. Suīrán Liángjiè hěn xiǎng zū, dànshì fù le fángzū yǐhòu, jiǎngxuéjīn jiù zhǐ shèngxià yíwàn kuài qián le. Tā wèn Wáng tàitai, fángzū kě bù kěyǐ piányí yìdiǎnr. Yīnwèi Wáng tàitai de érzi zài Fǎguó liúxué, tā zhīdào yígerén zài guówài shēnghuó bù róngyì. Tā xiǎng le xiǎng, juédìng zhǐ shōu Liángjiè yíwànliǎngqiān yuán de fángzū, Liángjiè hěn gāoxìng kěyǐ bānjiā le.
text.english: As soon as Ryosuke heard Mrs. Wang's apartment was for rent, he went with Kexin to have a look. The surroundings of the apartment were not bad and it was not too far away from the school. Although Ryosuke would like to rent it, he would have only $10,000 of his scholarship left after paying the rent. He asked Mrs. Wang whether the rent could be cheaper. Because Mrs. Wang's son has been studying in France, she knew that it was not easy to live abroad alone. After thinking it over, she decided to charge Ryosuke a rent of only $12,000. Ryosuke was happy that he could move.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 除了……還…… to add a second, more important point.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern indicates there are different situations coming after “除了” and “還”, with the latter one being even more important than the former. “除了” can be followed by nouns, verbs, intransitive state verbs (Vs) or phrases. If the Subjects of the two clauses are different, the second Subject should be placed before “還”, as in example 2.

text.traditional: 我除了喜歡吃蘋果，還喜歡吃香蕉。
text.simplified: 我除了喜欢吃苹果，还喜欢吃香蕉。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chúle xǐhuān chī píngguǒ, hái xǐhuān chī xiāngjiāo.
text.english: Besides liking to eat apples, I also like to eat bananas.

text.traditional: 很多人喜歡來這裡旅行，除了風景很好，交通還很方便。
text.simplified: 很多人喜欢来这里旅行，除了风景很好，交通还很方便。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xǐhuān lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng, chúle fēngjǐng hěn hǎo, jiāotōng hái hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Many people like to travel here. Besides the nice scenery, the transportation is also convenient.

text.traditional: A：白小姐生日的時候，男朋友送給她一個很貴的皮包。B：除了皮包，還送給她一輛車呢！
text.simplified: A：白小姐生日的时候，男朋友送给她一个很贵的皮包。B：除了皮包，还送给她一辆车呢！
text.pinyin: A: Bái xiǎojiě shēngrì de shíhòu, nánpéngyǒu sòng gěi tā yíge hěn guì de píbāo. B: Chúle píbāo, hái sòng gěi tā yí liàng chē ne!
text.english: A: On Miss Bai's birthday, her boyfriend gave her a very expensive purse. B: Besides the purse, he also gave her a car!

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern indicates there are different situations coming after “除了” and “還”, with the latter one being even more important than the former. “除了” can be followed by nouns, verbs, intransitive state verbs (Vs) or phrases. If the Subjects of the two clauses are different, the second Subject should be placed before “還”, as in example 2.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with V得 + comment
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 with V得 to say how an action leaves something.
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “把” is followed by the Object that receives the action of a verb, while “V得” is followed by the outcome after the action.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + 得 + Adv + Adjective

text.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
text.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
text.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī dehěn yuǎn.
text.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

text.traditional: 他把那隻兔子畫得很可愛。
text.simplified: 他把那只兔子画得很可爱。
text.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà zhī tùzi huà dehěn kě'ài.
text.english: He drew that rabbit so that it looks very cute.

text.traditional: 請你不要把這個問題弄得更麻煩。
text.simplified: 请你不要把这个问题弄得更麻烦。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ búyào bǎ zhège wèntí nòng de gèng máfán.
text.english: Please don't make this problem even more troublesome.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “把” is followed by the Object that receives the action of a verb, while “V得” is followed by the outcome after the action.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “把” is followed by the Object that receives the action of a verb, while “V得” is followed by the outcome after the action.
